title: refactor(helper): update tests [PART-3]
body:
This PR mostly update the snapshots of the `SearchParameters`. We don't have [default values](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/pull/670) anymore which means that the all the snapshots are outdated. It also updates tests that was relying on this behavior.

> The CI does not pass, it's expected. It won't pass until the last PR of the stack.

~~@Haroenv Nope the inline snapshots require Prettier and we don't have it set up on the project.~~

@samouss The InstantSearch.js setup supports Prettier. We use inline snapshots in [some tests](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/f4f05bdc30e3e6a88d6761731b303e85cbf3501b/src/helpers/__tests__/highlight-test.js#L77) already.

I think here we should use objects comparison with `toEqual` now that the search parameters are less noisy. Bouncing back and forth from test files to snapshots is a pain.
@francoischalifour Yep, my bad I thought I was in the Helper...  I agree on the idea but I don't think it's a good idea to do it inside this PR though. We can improve that later.
